_comment: Accepted findings for check-shadow-sources.py --check (D4/D5 shadow-tone follow-on, task-tone-4). Same discipline as editor-render-parity-baseline.json: --check reports NEW findings only (findings NOT listed here) and also fails on a baseline entry that no longer occurs (ratchet -- the baseline can only shrink). To accept a finding, add it here with a reason; to fix one, run --fix (or fix it by hand for a case --fix cannot reach), confirm it clears in --survey, then delete the entry.

_meta.note: Every entry here is src/blocks/google-reviews/style.css -- the one directory this task's --fix is forbidden to touch (another session's uncommitted work). PHP findings (helpers-shadow-filter.php, sgs-card-grid-variations.php) belong to the parallel PHP-owning agent's task and are deliberately NOT baselined here -- see task-tone-4-report.md.
